# Retro — target extraction and where an item ends

## Proposed kit deltas

1. **Item with a target.** Body text.
   → PROPOSED METHODOLOGY §3 markers: state the rule explicitly.

2. **Item without a target.** Body text only.

A closing paragraph at column 0 after a blank line is NOT part of item 2 and its marker is not item 2's
target. → PROPOSED §99 closing note: must never attach to an item.
